NEAR Builders Activity is a shared activity and reputation service for the NEAR ecosystem.

Organizations register Activity Sources, receive credentials, and submit source-defined events to a common HTTP gateway. The service signs and publishes accepted events to Nostr, maintains dynamically weighted activity scores, and exposes a verified public feed, live updates, and leaderboards.

Core capabilities:
- register and approve organization-owned Activity Sources
- create signing identities and scoped API keys
- ingest idempotent Activity events through POST /api/v1/events
- query or stream signature-verified events
- calculate weekly, monthly, and all-time leaderboards
- moderate public visibility without changing immutable Nostr records
- poll configured public GitHub repositories for mapped activity

Useful public paths:
- /
- /activity
- /activity-sources
- /organizations
- /docs
- /README.md
- /skill.md
- /site.webmanifest

Developer resources:
- Integration guide: https://github.com/NEARBuilders/activity.nearbuilders.org/blob/main/docs/integration-guide.md
- Activity protocol: https://github.com/NEARBuilders/activity.nearbuilders.org/blob/main/docs/activity-protocol.md
- Typed TypeScript client: @nearbuilders/activity-client (https://github.com/NEARBuilders/activity.nearbuilders.org/tree/main/packages/client)
- Public oRPC endpoint: https://activity.nearbuilders.org/api/rpc
- Public HTTP API and reference: https://activity.nearbuilders.org/api

Authentication:
- Source API Keys are server-side credentials sent as Authorization: Bearer act_...
- Routes requiring a signed-in user use session cookies.
